title: low-calorie egyptian epoisses bisque
description: a creamy, buttery, and crunchy one-pot dish featuring epoisses and shio-cure that's surprisingly low in calories

ingredients.name: epoisses cheese
ingredients.notes: use a low-calorie epoisses variant if possible

ingredients.name: low-fat coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat coconut milk can be used for a richer bisque, but it's higher in calories

instructions: heat 2 tbsp of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
add the shio-cure and cook for 1-2 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the epoisses has melted and the mixture has thickened slightly.
use an immersion blender to puree the bisque until smooth.
return the pot to the stovetop and add the low-fat coconut milk, chopped parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
stir well to combine and cook over low heat for another 2-3 minutes, until warmed through.
taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
note: for a creamier bisque, you can add 1-2 tbsp of low-fat cream or half-and-half towards the end of cooking time, but this will increase the calorie count slightly.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
